about: A save made mid-scene and loaded after the cell's mod shortened its scene list (scr_h) pointed past the list's end and stopped the game every frame ("Variable Index [2] out of range [1]" in scr_slot_state). The scene now ends and the cell idles. Fixture mid; the test cell is an empty vanilla breeding cell given a captive.

steps.why: back to idle instead of a GameMaker error
